book: Thomas Erastus, Heidelberg 1574 (Basel, Pernus): a volume of two works, the Disputatio de occultis medicamentorum proprietatibus (66 numbered chapters) and the Disputatio de medicamentorum purgantium facultate (three quaestiones), preceded by a dedication and an address to the reader and followed by a combined subject index.
